🎞️ SpriteAnimator

A pixel art canvas where you draw multiple frames, and the frames play back as an animation loop. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Draw on the canvas for frame 1.
  2. Use the frame navigation to advance to the next frame.
  3. Make small changes between frames — animation comes from subtle shifts.
  4. Play back the animation to see your creation in motion.
  5. Export your animation as a looping GIF or sprite sheet.
